mechanism: Acyclovir may increase deutetrabenazine levels through potential CYP3A4 inhibition and both drugs can cause CNS effects; acyclovir also has renal clearance concerns that may affect drug accumulation.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine adverse effects (sedation, akathisia, parkinsonism); consider renal function assessment and dose adjustment if needed; ensure adequate hydration with acyclovir use.
